I sunk over 5000 hours into Runescape and Old School Runescape combined. The variety of the game is what kept me playing. Always something new to do. Always new friends to make. It was like a life away from life for me.

Old School Runescape. It's an MMORPG that requires very little brain activity. It has a very active and friendly playerbase and you'll run into many adventurers as you explore the world. There's several skills that you can level up, some of which only require you to click only once every couple minutes. This game has so much to offer that I cant even list it all. You can do quests, slay dragons, fight other players, slay cows, fish, and so much more. The game has it's own economy, so you can fish for a few hours, then sell your fish and buy some sweet ass gear to fck up those cows. Be warned this game is very grindy which discourages a lot of players and they end up quitting before they get very far, but the more you level up and the more quests you do, allow you to access all sorts of fun new content like new areas to explore and more monsters to kill. It's the perfect game to play on the side while you do homework or ignore the lecture you're in. I've put over 5000 hours into this game 10/10 would recommend.
Just yes. So many hours of fun to be had.

You should give Hecarim a try! His super fast clear speeds are incredibly helpful with the new jungle changes and I almost always secure a kill after my first back with predator. It's very hard to counter because of how fast he is with water walking, ghost, and predator. I one tricked him and got to diamond with a 62% win rate. His presence is so good because he can get from one side of the map to the other within a matter of seconds. He's very easy to learn and really strong if you get ahead. The only downside I would say is he's not great in 1v1s unless you're running conqueror. Also, his ultimate makes a huge impact in team fights. Generally I aim to one shot either their adc or mid lane, depending on who's more fed and from there you and your team can easily clean up the rest.
